executiveSummary.visionAlignment: Constella aims to be an enterprise AI operating platform with a Chief Architect coordinating specialized agents. The technical direction largely supports this vision via a microservices-friendly gateway, a central orchestrator, and an observability stack.
executiveSummary.overallAssessment: Strong architectural intent with tangible progress on gateway security, rate limiting, and metrics. Orchestrator and agents are functionally present but require hardening for security, consistency, and production readiness. Multi-provider LLM integration is a differentiator.
keyStrengths: Unified API Gateway with JWT/API key auth, rate limiting, and Prometheus metrics (services/api-gateway)
Multi-provider LLM core (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter) with routing and tests (packages/llm-core, test scripts)
Observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) wired for platform telemetry (docker-compose.dev.yml)
Clear service decomposition and discovery model in gateway config (services/api-gateway/src/config)
keyWeaknessesAndRisks: Development defaults and weak secrets in configs (NEO4J_AUTH=none, Grafana admin=admin, dev JWT secret)
Inconsistent or missing auth on orchestrator/agents; broad CORS on orchestrator-py
No mTLS or service-to-service trust; metrics endpoints unauthenticated
Production deployment model not yet on Kubernetes; limited HA and autoscaling
Code quality issues in orchestrator (syntax/indentation error in main.py)
executiveSummary.businessImpact: Without security and operational hardening, enterprise adoption risks delays. Addressing auth, secrets, and deployment will unlock scalable pilots; LLM multi-provider capability positions the product competitively.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Harden secrets and defaults for dev & prod
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Remove weak defaults, require env overrides, and document secure setup.

replace: NEO4J_AUTH=none -> enable auth with strong password
Grafana admin default -> provision secrets via env/secret store
JWT_SECRET dev fallback -> mandatory strong secret in all envs

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Lock down CORS and protect /metrics in prod
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Restrict origins and require auth for metrics endpoints in production.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Fix orchestrator syntax error and add request validation
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Correct try/except indentation and add Pydantic models for all inputs.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Introduce service-to-service auth and mTLS
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Issue short-lived JWTs for agents and enable mTLS between gateway, orchestrator, and agents.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Standardize agent API contract and SDK
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Create a Python agent SDK template with health/capabilities/execute, auth, logging, and error schema.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Integrate OpenTelemetry
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Add distributed tracing across gateway, orchestrator, and agents; export to Tempo/Jaeger.

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Productionize on Kubernetes
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Helm charts/Argo CD, HPA, PodDisruptionBudgets, ServiceMonitors, and secret stores (Vault/Secrets Manager).

prioritizedRecommendations.title: Define SLOs and alerts
prioritizedRecommendations.action: Set error-rate and latency SLOs per service; wire Grafana/Alertmanager rules.
